environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed in 'auth-system' namespace on an Istio 1.20 mesh-enabled cluster. The Istio sidecar (envoy proxy) is injected into all pods via namespace label istio-injection=enabled. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with the following spec: action DENY for any source principal not matching 'cluster.local/ns/auth-system/sa/*'. This means only workloads with service accounts in the auth-system namespace itself can reach the pod. Additionally, the mesh operates in STRICT mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication with mtls.mode=STRICT at mesh level). The envoy sidecar terminates all inbound connections and validates the SPIFFE identity before forwarding to localhost:8080. External timing measurements are subject to envoy's connection pooling, HTTP/2 multiplexing jitter, and retry buffer timing normalization. The AuthorizationPolicy evaluation happens at the envoy layer before the request reaches the application container.
